chunks: Sa'd narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, who said:

I asked Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him): 'Do I pray the two rak'ahs of Fajr before the dawn prayer or after it?' He said: 'Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said: 'Combine them with the night prayer and pray them before the dawn prayer.'

key_terms.رَكْعَتَا الْفَجْرِ: The two rak'ahs of Fajr (sunnah prayer)

ai.seo_question: When should the two sunnah rak'ahs of Fajr be prayed?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies the preferred timing for the two sunnah rak'ahs of Fajr, recommending they be performed before the Fard prayer to be combined with the night prayer (Salat al-Layl). This practice highlights the Shia emphasis on maximizing voluntary worship by integrating it with established obligatory acts, thereby enhancing spiritual continuity before the dawn prayer.
